summary: A mixed briefing day with significant legal rulings, retail sector regulatory action, and major Reliance infrastructure developments. Key concerns include FSSAI enforcement against retail players and hijab judgment implications.

bullets.text: Allahabad HC rules hijab not essential religious practice, rejects Muslim student's plea to wear in school.
FSSAI suspends Marche Retail's license for 30 days over sanitation, hygiene violations; orders ghee sales halt.
Reliance, Rolls-Royce partner to build India's AMCA military engine; Ambani's Rs 2.7L cr infrastructure bet underway.
Renewable energy projects receive up to 4-month deadline extensions due to West Asia supply chain disruptions.
Starbucks India resumes aggressive expansion after 2-year business model overhaul; marks growth rebound.
